name: BullD.O.G.S. in Healthcare Summer Camp (Drake University)
org: Drake University College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
what_you_do: Spend a weekend on the Drake campus and try out health jobs. Join sessions on nursing, occupational therapy and pharmacy. Do hands-on labs. Visit a local health group.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in 2026-2027, or 2025 and 2026 high school graduates, who are interested in healthcare, math or science. Ages: not stated on the program page.
pay_detail: $200 per student. Financial help may be available for students who qualify.
duration: 3 days and 2 nights in a campus residence hall (July 9 to 11 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 9 to 11, 2026. Registration closed June 1, 2026 at noon. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Register online with the link on the program page and pay by the deadline. Questions go to Taylor Burgraff at taylor.burgraff@drake.edu or 515-271-1823.
notes: Meals are in the Hubbell Dining Hall. Spots are forfeited if payment is not made by the deadline. No refunds after the deadline.
